 Dated this the 10th day of June, 2025
 Judgment
1.
This LAA arises from LAR No. 36 of 2014.
2. 9.85 Ares of land belonging to the claimant was acquired.
The LAO granted compensation fixing land value at the rate of Rs.1,431/- per Are for 1.20 Ares and Rs.4,940/- per Are for 4.65 Ares, after deducting 4 Ares of land as permitted stand.
On an application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, the land value was fixed at Rs.2,545/- for the acquired land, excluding the deduction of 4 Ares as permitted stand.
3. In the impugned judgment, the Reference Court awarded compensation, fixing land value at the rate of Rs.6,000/- per Are for the entire 9.85 Ares.
The State has filed this appeal challenging the impugned judgment to the extent to which it granted compensation for 4 Ares, which were excluded as permitted stand.
4. LAR No. 36 of 2014 was considered by the Reference Court along with six other cases and disposed of by a common 2025:KER:40646 judgment.

In LAA No.305 of 2019 arising from LAR No.2 of 2015, this Court considered the question of permitted stand and held that the respondent has no right to exclude a part of the acquired property as permitted stand.
In view of the judgment in LAA No. 305 of 2019, the challenge of the State with respect to the grant of compensation with respect to the land excluded as permitted stand is unsustainable.

Sd/-
M.A.ABDUL HAKHIM, JUDGE Dxy State Of Kerala vs N.Raghavan Achary on 10 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144933494/
